Dumbarton Football Club is a semi-professional football club in Dumbarton, Scotland. Founded on 23 December 1872, they are one of the oldest football clubs in Scotland. Since December 2000, the club has played home games at The Rock next to Dumbarton Castle. A member of the SPFL, they currently compete in Scottish League Two, the fourth tier of Scottish football.
